name: Use design tokens instead of ad-hoc styles
statement: Use the shared design-token scale for spacing, color, typography, radius, elevation, and control geometry; do not introduce local raw values when an existing token expresses the same role.
rationale: Agent Studio and Quality Studio share a compact workbench vocabulary. Central tokens keep themes, density, accessibility, and cross-product visual kinship consistent.

badExample.description: A feature card invents spacing, color, and radius

goodExample.description: The feature uses the shared semantic scale
goodExample.code: .finding-card { padding: var(--studio-space-3); border-radius: var(--studio-radius-card); color: var(--studio-fg-muted); }

history.change: Initial default-on rule covering the operator-observed ad-hoc style defect class and the shared --studio-* token system.
